label: Bible Study
prompt: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may _____ that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
verse: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
note: Not hope-so but know-so — John wrote this letter for assurance.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the _____, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.
verse: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.
note: David's great prayer of praise: thine is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, the majesty — and the kingdom.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the _____, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
verse: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
note: The KJV's 'doctors' were teachers of the law — and twelve-year-old Jesus sat among them asking questions.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work _____, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
verse: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
note: Enemies kept inviting Nehemiah to a 'meeting'; he kept replying he was too busy with a great work.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the manna was as _____ seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
verse: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
note: Manna looked like 'coriander' seed and tasted like wafers made with honey (Exodus 16:31) — and Israel still complained.
